purpose: Separate zero-shot source-conditioned edit responsiveness from corpus next-token competence and from KSGT governance effects. This contract is not a replacement for held-out human adjudication.

frozen_assumptions.consequence: Do not rely on <src>/<ctx>/<cand> as learned protocol tokens; use ordinary Korean source/context wording for zero-shot entry.
frozen_assumptions.causality: Failure on this route identifies this proposer-plus-entry instrument, not a general failure of the underlying language model family or KSGT governor.

serialized_primary_route.input_authority: Frozen PIA source text and source-linked task instruction only; no hidden reference rewrite examples
serialized_primary_route.task_instruction_rule: Translate only the source-packet task code via the frozen two-row Korean map below. All 24 packet rows require a nonidentity task response; never use hidden references, style targets or PIA outcomes to create instructions. Unknown task codes are a hard hold.
serialized_primary_route.overlimit_rule: Typed SOURCE_TOO_LONG / no source truncation / do not silently exclude the item from 24-item PIA denominator
serialized_primary_route.source_normalization: No NFKC or semantic paraphrase; preserve original source bytes/codepoints except transport encoding
serialized_primary_route.sentinel_collision_rule: If source contains 【원문】 or 【수정문】, mark SOURCE_DELIMITER_COLLISION before generation, retain in denominator, never silently escape/mutate source or parse it as outer instruction.
serialized_primary_route.bos_policy: No additional BOS inserted unless baseline model training already used BOS; pretrained corpus emits EOS only.
serialized_primary_route.stop_rule: Stop at EOS or 256 generated tokens; never include generated task explanation inside candidate text as silently filtered repair.

frozen_task_map.minimal Korean correction: 오탈자와 문법 오류만 필요한 만큼 최소한으로 교정하세요.
frozen_task_map.meaning-preserving Korean paraphrase: 의미를 보존하면서 원문과 표현이 다른 한국어 문장을 제시하세요.

frozen_source_admission.source_content_sha256: Compare original source text SHA256 against its frozen packet source_sha256 on every entry. It must be bound to the original item_id by the packet loader.
frozen_source_admission.task_family_mapping: KOLLA_* must map to 'minimal Korean correction'; STYLEKQC_GENERIC must map to 'meaning-preserving Korean paraphrase'
frozen_source_admission.no_op_permission: false for the current fixed 24-item entry court; raw identity remains visible and is not automatically PASS
frozen_source_admission.any_integrity_failure: Typed hold retained in 24-item denominator, not a silent skip

candidate_generation.candidate0: Primary PIA instrument probe per source, fixed before outcomes.
candidate_generation.candidates1to3: Secondary candidate-set coverage only; cannot rescue candidate0 PIA admission. Do not selectively regenerate failures.
candidate_generation.duplicate_policy: Retain 4 attempt receipts; preserve duplicate multiplicity for coverage accounting, deduplicate candidate set only after receipts without generating replacements.
candidate_generation.native_ordering: Candidate index ascending; no learned judge, governor score, or evaluator reranking.
candidate_generation.same_proposer_arms: Persist exact four raw candidate outputs and hash a canonical frozen candidate-set receipt before running U/K selection.

output_classes.candidate: Nonempty decoded candidate. Always retain raw output and provenance.
output_classes.no_op_policy: All 24 frozen PIA tasks require a task response (KoLLA correction or StyleKQC paraphrase); mechanically flag unchanged or whitespace-only output as candidate0 TASK_NONRESPONSE evidence for adjudicator. Do not automatically award source-copy PASS.
output_classes.gross_reject_gate: Use frozen 24-item PIA thresholds unchanged. Typed absence of a candidate is assessed as task nonresponse or malformed output, not silently dropped.
output_classes.hard_cargo: Preservation is independently adjudicated; automatic lexical equality cannot overrule semantic contradiction or fabrication.

attribution_matrix.what_it_tests: Joint model+prompt ability to produce meaningful source-responsive edits
attribution_matrix.cannot_claim: Capacity threshold in an instruction-tuned writing family

attribution_matrix.what_it_tests: Instrumental acceptable/local-repairable support under fixed entry route
attribution_matrix.cannot_claim: Human revision burden, KSGT benefit, or population quality

attribution_matrix.what_it_tests: Whether any viable candidate occurs in frozen proposal reservoir
attribution_matrix.cannot_claim: Performance of native single proposal or governor causal gain
Effect of a different generator or after-outcome resampling

negative_controls.name: IDENTITY_SOURCE_COPY
negative_controls.purpose: Catch source identity erroneously counted as successful task completion
negative_controls.adjudication: No-op condition is task-conditioned; no free PASS

negative_controls.name: SOURCE_SWAP
negative_controls.purpose: Measure input sensitivity when source string changes under a frozen prompt/seed
negative_controls.adjudication: Diagnostic only; a change in output is not semantic-preservation evidence

negative_controls.name: CARGO_RECALL
negative_controls.purpose: Lexically check selected numbers/names when listed in frozen task context
negative_controls.adjudication: Sufficient to flag some omissions, insufficient to certify meaning

reporting.attention: Do not condition analysis on successful decoding only; failures remain in denominator.

fail_branches.SLM_AR_ALL_FAIL: PIA_FLOOR_PERSISTS_MODEL_PLUS_ROUTE_UNDERPREPARED; no family-local threshold or governance-effect interpretation.
fail_branches.SLM_AR_PARTIAL_PASS: Family-local passing set at presealed exposure/route only; no monotonic threshold forced.
fail_branches.RIVAL_EDIT_PASS_SLM_AR_FAIL: Proposal-mechanism/conditioning effect identified; not KSGT governor superiority.
fail_branches.ANY_PASS: Governance U/K remains forbidden until candidate set committed unchanged and PIA entry rules satisfied.

freeze_lock: This entry-route contract may not be modified after observing checkpoint dev losses or PIA outcomes without invalidating same-snapshot confirmatory comparison.
